title: ADA Compliant Grab Bar 63-Inch 3-Post Wall Mount Iron Pipe | Matte Gray | Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom safety and support with an ADA compliant grab bar featuring a long 63-inch span and a 3-post mounting design for enhanced stability in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials.

  • Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • 3-post grab bar: includes a third center bracket to help ensure stability
  • ADA compliant: designed to meet accessibility-focused bathroom needs
  • Wall mount: keeps floor space clear while providing a secure handhold location
  • Powder coat protection: highly durable finish engineered for corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specifications

  • Overall length: 63 in
  • Height: 3 in
  • Width/Projection: 3.58 in
  • Weight capacity: 250 lb
  • Product weight: 5 lb
  • Material: Iron Pipe
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
  • Multiple designer finish options available
